description: This file defines classes related to configuration options for Consul clustering in Orleans, including setting up the Consul client, validation, and configuration validation.

classes.name: ConsulClusteringOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for Consul clustering, including KV root folder and client factory, with methods to configure and validate the options.

classes.name: ConsulClusteringOptionsValidator<TOptions>
classes.description: Provides validation for ConsulClusteringOptions instances, ensuring proper configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureConsulClient
methods.description: Sets the CreateClient factory using a callback.

methods.name: ConfigureConsulClient
methods.description: Configures the CreateClient factory using a URI address and optional ACL token.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates that the CreateClient factory is set, throws exception if not.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the options, calling their Validate method.
